b0.pin: replay of the retained coin series b0

preregistered.estimates: per template and batch kind, the contrast of each batch, read on the order and the times the provider executed it (the instant of each job's queued_at, in integer microseconds) and pooled by inverse variance: base, the raw arm contrast P(s=0 | coin read 1) - P(s=0 | coin read 0); twin, t = (P1 - c) - (P0 - c) = P1 - P0 over the two coin twins of one batch, P the raw P(s=0) of a twin and c = (e10 - e01) / 2 the offset of the batch's own readout-0 and readout-1, which cancels in t; the variance of t sums the arm variances of P1 and P0, a deterministic arm taking the Agresti-Coull interval variance; the twin and base rows enter the pool as the executed_order and base_level rules correct them
preregistered.heterogeneity: replicate batches of one template and kind agree within chi-square 16.266 (3 degrees of freedom, alpha 0.001: the quantile of this case's 4 replicates, where the predecessor's 10.828 is the 1-degree-of-freedom value of its 2); the three 6-CZ blocks agree within chi-square 9.21 (2 degrees of freedom, alpha 0.01) for the base contrasts and for the twin contrasts; otherwise the decision is unresolved
preregistered.control: b0 base contrast s0 above 3.0 se, else the offset is absent and nothing about its mechanism is decided
preregistered.twin_control: b0 twin contrast t0 above 3.0 se; if not, t0 within 3.0 se of zero (|t0| <= 3.0 se) and s0 - t0 above 3.0 combined se, the offset exists only with the coin in superposition; t0 below -3.0 se is unresolved (negative twin); otherwise unresolved
preregistered.six_cz: c and d the inverse-variance means of the three 6-CZ base and twin contrasts, m their combination and r the combination of s0 and t0: contexts disagree when |c - d| exceeds 3.0 combined se; zero when |m| is within 3.0 se and r - m exceeds 3.0 combined se; b0-like when m exceeds 3.0 se and |r - m| is within 2.0 combined se; intermediate (unresolved) when m exceeds 3.0 se outside that band; otherwise unresolved
preregistered.calibration: the eight X-only preparations of q2, q8 and q12 are a secondary readout calibration in a terminal-assignment context: D, the selector misassignment with the coin prepared 1 minus 0 at a prepared selector 1, and G, with q12 prepared 0 minus 1, are reported with large (>= 0.036 - 3.0 se) and small (|.| + 3.0 se < 0.012) classes and change no outcome
preregistered.qx: every circuit within twice the sampling floor of its ideal law
preregistered.executed_order: v_b = t_T + g x_b + e_b over the twin batches b by weighted least squares, one drift g shared by every twin batch, one contrast t_T per template and x_b the executed place of the coin-1 twin minus that of the coin-0 twin among the circuits of batch b; each twin row is reduced by g x_b and its error multiplied by sqrt(1 + x_T^2 var(g) W_T); the template contrasts pool with the covariance x_T x_U var(g) that the shared drift gives them
preregistered.base_level: the base level of a template is read at the mean executed time of its twin circuits through a weighted line over its four base replicates at their executed times; each base row is reduced by the slope times its time offset and its error multiplied by sqrt(1 + (t_w - tau)^2 / S_tt)
preregistered.drift_monitor: the bracket offset c of each of the 32 base and twin batches, placed at the mean executed time of its two readouts, fits a line in time within the alpha 0.001 chi-square quantile of n - 2 degrees of freedom; the slope bound g_up |t - tau| of each X-only calibration batch is reported beside the decision
preregistered.withheld: the decision is withheld, the first of these in order, as unresolved_order (a start stamp is missing, null, not an ISO 8601 instant with an offset, or two circuits of a twin batch start at one instant), unresolved_order_confounded (every template keeps one position offset), unresolved_base_drift_confounded (a template's base replicates share one start time), unresolved_drift_model (the monitor refuses the line) and unresolved_drift_heterogeneity (a template's own drift departs from the shared drift by more than 3 errors of the difference); the label of the pool that ignores the order stays beside the reading
